original.target_description: Verified supplied Riccelli et al. (2017) title and DOI. This is a Human Connectome Project study of five-factor personality traits and cortical anatomy, not a concealed-information test of orienting/inhibition or psychophysiological responses. Abstract: “we used Free-Surfer to study how variability in SBM measures was related to the FFM”. The supplied p.6 locator cannot identify a matching target in this work.

replication.target_description: Verified supplied klein Selle et al. (2017) title and DOI. Study compares conceal/reveal motivational conditions and high/low item salience using SCR, RLL, and HR. Locator p.5 is procedural material when counting the repository cover, or journal p.632 when counting article pages; p.632 contains several distinct ANOVA main effects and interactions. The neutral description does not specify a physiological outcome, factor, interaction, or contrast, so no unique target test or corresponding analytic n can be selected.

n.exclusions: Not established for the unidentified target test

notes: Original source acquired from Europe PMC fullTextXML for PMC5390726 after the DOI landing page returned 403; title and DOI verified against Europe PMC metadata. Original reference is a known topic mismatch, so its unrelated statistics and sample total are not assigned to this target. Replication contains printed Cohen’s f values for multiple candidate tests on article p.5 (journal p.632), and further planned contrasts on p.633; choosing among them would require an outcome/test identifier absent from the blind input. Replication sample varies by physiological measure and complete-case analysis; generic enrollment is not assigned as analytic n. The successful narrative verdict refers to the replication authors’ stated confirmation of klein Selle et al. (2016), not to replication of the supplied Riccelli et al. original. No inference about success of that mismatched pair is made.
